verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents lifecycle automation covering creation, access changes and termination across the identity lifecycle (docs-20). Its HRIS integration onboards new hires and removes departing employees with minimal manual intervention (docs-24, docs-11). However, its 'automatic onboarding and offboarding workflows' are described as running through RESTful commands, APIs and PowerShell (docs-4, docs-3), which are developer building blocks rather than a no-code workflow builder. missing for 10: a documented no-code, event-triggered workflow builder; explicit per-app provisioning and deprovisioning choreography on hire, role change and departure; role-change-specific triggers; independent or hands-on corroboration.
